name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
shortDescription: Income support scheme of ₹6,000 per year for all landholding farmer families.
description: PM-KISAN is a central sector scheme that aims to provide income support to all landholding farmer families across the country. Under this scheme, an amount of ₹6,000 per year is released in three equal installments of ₹2,000 each directly into the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.
benefits: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to bank account
eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable landholding in their names
Must have a valid Aadhaar card
Certain categories of higher economic status are excluded

name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
shortDescription: Crop insurance scheme to provide financial support in case of crop failure.
description: The Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana provides comprehensive crop insurance from pre-sowing to post-harvest period against non-preventable natural risks at an extremely low premium rate for farmers.
benefits: Comprehensive insurance cover against crop failure
Low premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops
Use of technology (smartphones, drones) for quick assessment
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
shortDescription: Provides adequate and timely credit support from the banking system.
description: The KCC scheme aims at providing adequate and timely credit support to farmers for their cultivation and other needs, including agriculture inputs and working capital requirements for allied activities.
benefits: Flexible limit based on cropping pattern and land area
eligibility: Individual farmers/joint borrowers who are owner cultivators
Tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers
Self Help Groups (SHGs) or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
shortDescription: Promotes organic farming through a cluster approach.
description: PKVY is a traditional farming improvement program that promotes organic farming through a cluster approach and PGS (Participatory Guarantee System) certification. It aims to increase domestic production and certification of organic produce by involving farmers.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare for 3 years
Support for organic inputs (seeds, bio-fertilizers, bio-pesticides)
Assistance for capacity building and certification
eligibility: Must form a cluster having 50 acres or 20 hectares in a continuous patch

name: MahaDBT Shetkari Yojana
shortDescription: Umbrella portal for various agricultural schemes in Maharashtra.
description: The MahaDBT portal offers a single window for farmers in Maharashtra to apply for various agricultural schemes including micro-irrigation, farm mechanization, and horticulture programs.
benefits: Subsidies on agricultural equipment and machinery
Support for horticulture and shade net houses
eligibility: Must be a resident farmer of Maharashtra

name: Rythu Bandhu Scheme
shortDescription: Agriculture Investment Support Scheme for farmers in Telangana.
description: Rythu Bandhu provides investment support for agriculture and horticulture crops by way of a grant of ₹5,000 per acre per season to farmers for purchase of inputs like seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, and labor.
benefits: ₹10,000 per acre per year (₹5,000 per season: Kharif and Rabi)
Direct Benefit Transfer to farmer accounts
No cap on the number of acres eligible
eligibility: Must be a resident farmer of Telangana
